svg.title: Issue 1 — Page 1 — Panel 4: Jink on jump seat, restless
svg.desc: Medium shot, slight 5° dutch angle. Jink half-sitting on a minimal military jump seat, one leg drawn up, the other dangling, one hand drumming on knee. Looking sideways at a narrow rectangular wall-mounted viewport behind them where the temporal corridor rushes past in prismatic streaks. Restless, slight smirk, barely contained energy. Cool prismatic light from viewport casts shifting geometric patterns on emerald suit. Ambient blue-white overhead. JINK: "How many of these have we done? Twelve?" / SABLE (off-panel): "Fourteen." / JINK: "They're starting to blur."
